items.text: All round 2 decisions incorporated into plan.md. Key changes: (1) Added explicit 'Filter Persistence' contract section — filters persist per-tab in the reducer during a session, but URL only encodes the active tab's filters; inactive tabs reset on page reload. (2) Added 'Empty & Loading States' contract section — simple text-with-icon empty states, pulsing skeleton for initiative-store loading. (3) Added empty state and loading state test cases to Testing Plan. (4) Updated URL state integration tests to verify per-tab filter persistence behavior and active-tab-only URL encoding. (5) Updated Rollout/Validation checklist with filter persistence and empty/loading state items. (6) Added greenfield statement and Final Cleanup & Verification phase per plan-authoring conventions.

No remaining gaps. All 8 decisions across rounds 1–2 are resolved and reflected in the plan. The plan covers all 13 expected deliverables from the spec: search bar, client-side search, tab bar, activity tab, entity tabs, filter controls, sort controls, full-viewport mobile, input zoom prevention, app-like mobile feel, desktop width, graph node selection, and URL state. The initiative-store is the only new Zustand store; all other data sources already exist.

Readiness assessment: problem_clarity=3 (fully understood from existing code analysis), scope_defined=3 (acceptance_allow set to scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/**, no acceptance_deny needed per round 2 d3), approach_solid=3 (6-phase strategy with specific file/component targets and existing pattern references), testable=3 (unit + component + integration test plan with specific test cases), risk_awareness=3 (6 risks identified with mitigations, including the new per-tab filter reload tradeoff).
